panels.title: Idle time left
panels.description: Seconds until the idle timeout returns the GPU to Qwen. Also ends early if an LLM request is refused while MOSS is idle.

panels.title: All-Time Model Performance (lifetime totals; survive restarts and Prometheus's 30d retention)
Lifetime Avg Generation Speed (tok/s) · efficiency ranking
panels.description: The most efficient model, all time: lifetime generated tokens / lifetime generation wall-time, by model. Backed by watoom-model-perf-accumulator.py, which accumulates deltas from llamacpp: counters into a durable state file so the ranking survives both llama.cpp restarts and Prometheus's 30-day retention window.

panels.title: Lifetime Generated Tokens · most-used model
panels.description: Total output tokens generated by each model since the accumulator was deployed. A volume/usage ranking, distinct from the speed ranking: a model can be fast but rarely used, or slow but heavily relied on.

panels.title: Lifetime Totals by Model (raw drill-down)
panels.description: Includes MOSS image studio (images/pixels, no tokens) alongside LLMs (tokens/seconds). The Creation Studio GLB 3D coder is not yet represented here -- it does not currently export any Prometheus metrics or register with the GPU ownership controller (see T-0104/T-0103), so there is no lifetime data to show for it.

description: Model-centric monitoring for WatooM local llama.cpp inference. Shows active-model state, per-model inference throughput and latency, workload, queue state and GPU GPU telemetry. Detailed Request Performance uses exact llama-server timing values parsed by the platform-workers Vector worker.
